title: Balancing out Bias: Achieving Fairness Through Balanced Training

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating True Positive Rate (TPR) and True Negative Rate (TNR) gaps in a binary sentiment analysis task using tweets categorized by dialect as a proxy for race (African American English vs. Standard American English).
